visualCharacteristics: Contained-width rotating banner: each slide is a 3/4-width linked banner image (headline and CTA are baked into the image) beside a 1/4-width white caption panel with intro paragraph; blue indicator bar with 3 dots at bottom right. Slides pair a 3/4-width linked banner image with a 1/4-width caption panel on the right; dot indicators on a blue bar under the caption. No vanilla/existing variant matches the side caption layout.
contentPattern: Interactive rotating slideshow with indicators; each slide is an image plus a caption text cell.

blockStructure.notes: One row per slide (3 slides). Banner headline/CTA are part of the image; keep the image link.

usage: Homepage rotating banner where each slide pairs a linked banner image (headline/CTA baked in) with a short intro caption panel to its right.
reuseGuidance: Use for image + side caption slideshows. For full-bleed slides with overlaid text, use the base carousel instead. One row per slide: cell 1 image (optionally linked), cell 2 caption text.
